selection: The exact first 40 seeded examples from the historical public receipt, with identical source archive digests. Defaults were fixed before the run; no k or budget tuning on evaluation outcomes.
previous_incomplete_cohorts: Excluded. One earlier link cohort completed 52 model requests before one prompt-length refusal (one inventory request is excluded); incomplete earlier triage totals are unavailable. Partial receipts remain tracked by pm-jev-w1zj.
metric_denominators: Accuracy and ECE use the answered population shown per arm. Baseline threshold curves are conditional on answered examples; summary coverage_at_empirical_precision_90 uses all 40 targets. Empirical precision is descriptive and does not establish autonomous qualification.
